$comment: Targets for scripts/live-checklist.js. One entry per public product URL (custom domain first when it exists). `expect` says which checks must pass for this target; a check that is not expected is still run and reported, but does not count against the target. checkout is false on zorbeck.com because the landing page links to /x-autopilot/ (whose Start buttons only become checkout links per configured PRICE_ID_XA_*), not to a /checkout or Stripe URL; login is false because the landing page offers no sign-in.
